description_addendum: Local Noether support packet R247 clarifies source routes and native-resolution limits for Papers 15 and 16. It applies no TeX patch. The known P15 Latin-x-index and Schur S.355 repairs and the P16 F-not-Phi repair already survive in the current R225 German base. P15 remains best-available from a 360ppi article PDF plus a 400ppi title witness; P16 remains best-available from 360ppi/400ppi or undefined-DPI witnesses. Bad-offset P16 GDZ canvases 00000025-00000030 must not be used as P16 authority. Old 1000dpi-labelled crops are enlarged known-locus witnesses only.
display_guidance: Do not front this support packet above reader PDFs/TeX. Prefer folding it into a compact Noether source-audit support rollup if Noether support material is refreshed.
quality_caveat: No strict 650+ page-by-page certification is claimed for P15/P16 from current local source witnesses. No source closure, corpus certification, multilingual synchronization, or critical-edition claim.
